justification: Standard: changes the text comparison that proves a control's quote is on its page, which gates what is served. Not Minor: it can change verdicts for other councils. Not Critical: the old comparison is kept and the better verdict wins, so no match that worked before can turn into a miss; writes happen only in a separate apply.

pre_impl.existing_data: Waverley controls 1104 and 1106 hold the sentence with 25m followed by a superscript 2 and read not_found; the PDF text has 25m2. 15 controls across strathfield (13), waverley (3 incl. these), liverpool and fairfield contain a superscript sign; 11 of 13 Strathfield ones read not_found.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: I assumed a correct quote would prove; the comparison dropped the superscript from the quote but kept the digit in the PDF text.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: norm already strips punctuation on both sides; it now also has a folding mode, and classify tries both modes and keeps the better verdict.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A PDF that drops the sign entirely still matches through the old mode.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A correct council quote is held back as not found, or a quote with a different number is called proven.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A superscript quote against a flattened PDF digit is not verbatim, a PDF that keeps or loses the sign stops matching, or 25 matches 35.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: With folding off the flattened-digit test fails; with the old mode off the lost-sign test fails.

functions.name: classify
functions.input: a stored quote, the chapter's page texts and the cited PDF page
functions.if_none: no quote, no page or unreadable PDF is no_source

functions.name: norm
functions.input: a text and whether to read superscripts as digits
functions.output: the lower-case letters, digits, dots and percent signs only
functions.if_none: an empty text gives an empty string

values.read_at: the stored control text and the best matching sentence
values.if_missing: scores 0 and the control stays held

queries.purpose: No new query; the checker reads the same controls and PDF pages as before

break_it.scenario: The PDF keeps the superscript sign.
break_it.what_happens: Folding both sides could still be expected to match.
break_it.how: Both sides fold the same way, and the old mode runs too.

break_it.scenario: The PDF loses the sign entirely.
break_it.what_happens: Folding would turn the quote into 25m2 against 25m and miss.
break_it.how: The old mode runs as well and the better verdict stands.

break_it.scenario: A different number appears with the flattened digit.
break_it.what_happens: 35m2 could be called a match for 25m.
break_it.how: Folding changes only the sign into its own digit; the other digits still differ.

break_it.scenario: The checker reads the same controls and PDF pages as before and the PDF cannot be read.
break_it.what_happens: Every control could read as not found.
break_it.how: An unreadable PDF returns no_source in both modes and never not_found.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dcp_quote_status.py --council waverley (dry run) then --apply after the owner's go; 1104 and 1106 should read verbatim.
